# Incubate cells with stimulus for 5 h at 37 °C

wash_cells(volume_of_buffer_per_well="200 µL")

# Centrifuge to pellet debris

dry_pellet(time="5 min")

# Add AL buffer and ethanol, then isopropanol precipitation

add_KOAc(volume="200 µL", KOAc_solution="ethanol")
isopropanol_precipitation(volume="1 mL", temperature="-20°C", time="30 min", speed="14000 x g")

# Wash pellet with ethanol
etoh_wash(volume="1 mL", temperature="4°C", time="5 min", speed="14000 x g")
dry_pellet(time="2 min")

# Resuspend pellet in AE buffer

# Quantify DNA
